intent: metadata for automatic post-push validation and release
note: Every completed push to main automatically validates and publishes a new unreleased manifest/request version only if all checks pass and the commit is still current.
changes: Opt-in per-room Mold Indicator replaces raw RH as ventilation trigger using HA's cold-surface temperature calibration formula
Initial Rooms step enables mold mode; Room settings is the second options entry with per-room sensor exclusions and measured coldest-surface temperature
Average all included physically valid nonzero RH readings per room, ignoring unavailable, stale, nonnumeric, zero and values above 100%
Preserve the original calibration factor across subsequent weather or sensor updates; explicit recalibration after new measurement
Derived estimated surface humidity (70% initial warning threshold) and calibration diagnostics included in dashboard and localized messages
New mode is off by default; existing RH, CO2, weather warnings and Announcement Hub behavior remain intact
Expanded regression coverage for mold math, option flow, missing data, averaging and frontend; translated configuration in all 38 languages
